reviews.text: If you're looking for the number one educator in Marseille, you've come to the right place! 😉

Morgane is a fantastic dog trainer, very attentive and observant. She was able to connect with my dog, easily identify his difficulties, and propose a suitable training program. I've already seen improvements in his behavior and a decrease in his anxiety!
Morgane is a very good dog trainer. Her training sessions with Alto have allowed me to better understand my puppy and feel confident about his progress. Thank you for everything.
Best behaviorist trainer, hands down! Don't hesitate to contact her for your furry friends! I highly recommend her! ⭐️ 🤗 …

I thank Morgane for her help; she is an excellent teacher when it comes to animals. Her advice taught me a great deal, and I was able to correct some clumsy mistakes and misunderstandings I had regarding my dog. After just a few sessions, my dog ​​made significant progress, and the sessions were very beneficial. I highly recommend her!

I'm so glad I didn't skimp on hiring a behaviorist like Morgane. When you welcome a puppy into your home, you quickly realize it's not just about "training," but above all, about understanding. Morgane doesn't just give exercises; she taught me to read my dog, to understand her emotions, her needs, and her way of communicating.

Thanks to her, I'm learning to understand Akela better, but also to observe other dogs and to guide my puppy more calmly, both in her world and in ours. It completely transforms the relationship we're building.

With a young puppy, there are bound to be moments of doubt, fatigue, or misunderstanding (especially when she has trouble with bite inhibition), and Morgane's support has been invaluable during those times. She's kind, very patient, and always attentive.

I sincerely recommend her work to anyone who wants to create a fairer and more peaceful relationship with their partner.

The only thing we regret is not seeing her anymore. But adolescence is coming, so we'll soon be back in class!
Excellent experience. Morgane is very professional and gives a lot of great advice. I highly recommend her.
Morgane is a fantastic educator; the sessions are completely customized and take place wherever you are, whether it's your neighborhood, your home, or your workplace. I highly recommend her!

An exceptional trainer, attentive and very kind. Highly observant, she immediately understood our dynamic. I'm truly happy to have met her: she restored my confidence with my dog, and the progress is visible at every session.

A truly passionate dog trainer with excellent advice.
My dog ​​adores her!
She's always very punctual, and scheduling appointments is very smooth.
Well done, Morgane!
Thank you so much Marc 🐾 …
Morgane was great, she is passionate, she explains things clearly and intelligently, I highly recommend her.

Morgane is a fantastic trainer! Patient, always attentive, and available, she works with passion and understanding, respecting your pet and adapting to each individual.

I recommend her 100%.

Morgane was recommended to me for my dog, a young beagle who had many behavioral problems. He was aggressive with us and fearful around strangers, sometimes uncontrollable. In just a few sessions, we've seen a lot of progress. I highly recommend her; you can trust her completely. She's a specialist and very patient.

I contacted Morgane for my puppy Albert. I was looking for a dog trainer for my border collie's behavioral issues, and Morgane de Hear was recommended to me. The training sessions were very beneficial for my dog, who is now extremely well-behaved and socialized. I highly recommend this behaviorist! Thank you so much!

After adopting my puppy, I experienced the dreaded "puppy blues." My daily life was turned upside down, and I didn't know how to help my dog ​​and train him properly. Hear Education has been supporting me for several sessions now, and I thank her a thousand times over. I've seen nothing but positive results since then, and I can't wait to teach him even more thanks to her!

A gem! She helped me so much and continues to do so today. She made the relationship I have with my dog ​​possible and is a resource for both of us.
It's a joy to have her there for us through thick and thin.

I was looking for a dog trainer in Marseille for my puppy who was nipping and relieving himself everywhere, and I was recommended Morgane from Hear Positive Dog Training. In just a few sessions, my puppy learned to be housebroken, to settle down, and most importantly, I learned to communicate with him without yelling or frustration. Her methods are gentle and effective; you can tell she's a positive and passionate trainer. I recommend her 100%! Thank you so much!
Excellent follow-up
Morgane is an exceptional trainer, very professional and passionate. Thanks to her, my dog ​​has made great progress. I highly recommend her!

Morgane is an excellent trainer. In just one session, she really helped us understand Vyko and how to meet his needs. Her advice in the report allowed us to progress and achieve results quickly. I highly recommend her!

Morgane is a very competent and pleasant behaviorist. She greatly helped us with our dog, Loulou, who was terrified of the outdoors and people. In just a few sessions, she helped us make real progress with our dog. I wholeheartedly recommend her services. If you're looking for someone to help you and your dog, Morgane is the right person.

Thank you again for your help.
Mathieu, Axelle, and Milo

We contacted Morgane for our one-year-old dog, who was very fearful. The slightest eye contact with a human could trigger a disproportionate reaction (fear, panic, barking, running away), and many other complex situations. In just four sessions, Milo made incredible progress thanks to her help. Morgane is a truly fantastic behaviorist, very attentive, and adapts to each situation and new request, creating personalized exercises to help our dog progress as much as possible. Unfortunately, we had to move, but we wish we could have taken her with us. She is very professional, often checks in between sessions, and sets goals for the next appointment. You can trust her completely.

Thank you, Morgane, we miss you so much. Unfortunately, the trainers in our new area aren't as competent as you.

Axelle, Mathieu, and Milo 🐶

My dog ​​used to pull on the leash, and walks were unbearable. I was looking for a dog trainer in Marseille, and Morgane was recommended to me. She found the solutions, and now Guizmo is relaxed on walks! It's changed my life, thank you Morgane!
Morgane was able to help us better understand our puppy's behavioral profile with kindness and common sense. We'll stay in touch if needed.

I wholeheartedly recommend Morgane! Thanks to her kind and highly professional guidance, I've seen a real improvement in my dog's behavior. She takes the time to explain each step and truly adapts to both the dog and its owner.

A huge thank you for this fantastic support; I'm so glad I contacted her!

Absolutely fantastic! Morgane is truly a trustworthy person who clicked perfectly with Charly, my little dog! She was able to find solutions to her behavioral problems quickly and effectively! I recommend her without hesitation!

I contacted Morgane for my puppy and I'm thrilled with the experience! I was looking for something similar to puppy classes, and I found something even better by trusting Morgane! From the very first training session, she put me at ease and gave me clear, tailored, and kind advice. Thanks to her, my puppy Nuage is making giant strides. You can tell she truly loves her job and has a real passion for dogs. I recommend her without hesitation!
Morgane is very professional and incredibly effective at training our four-legged friends. My dog ​​learns very quickly with her. Thank you for everything!
Thank you for this lovely note!

Morgane is attentive and very responsive.
I highly recommend her!

Thank you again to Morgane for her professionalism and kindness.

I highly recommend Morgane, who helped me understand my dog's behavior, better meet his needs, and strengthen our bond. Morgane is very patient, friendly, always attentive, and offers excellent advice. A beautiful soul who deserves to be known! Socks and I thank her 🫶 …

I was lucky enough to work with Morgane as a dog trainer, and I can't recommend her highly enough! From our very first contact, she established a relationship of trust with both me and my dog.
Thanks to her, I've seen real progress and learned to better understand my four-legged friend's needs.

A truly wonderful encounter! Morgane is attentive, professional, a great teacher, and dedicated to her work. She has helped my dog ​​and me make tremendous progress.

I highly recommend her! You can go with complete confidence!
Thank you again!

Thank you to Morgane for her excellent advice and support! She really helped us better understand our Labrador, who had trouble managing his emotions with other dogs and also pulled a lot on the leash. We worked on it together and it's only gotten better!

Excellent analysis, personalized follow-up, I highly recommend it!!!

And as a bonus, an online report section

Morgane was very friendly, professional, and attentive during our first meeting. Our dog is very fearful of strangers, but her calming energy helped our dog feel comfortable with her. She listened to our dog's issues with fear and stress during walks, as well as separation anxiety, and gave us many suggestions to help acclimate our dog to new experiences. She accompanied us on a walk to assess our dog and give us advice on how to keep him calm and reduce his reactivity to other dogs. She also gave us tips on things we were doing that were causing our puppy more stress.

She is very kind, and I highly recommend Morgane for any person or dog training! She even spoke English during the assessment and was very patient with our French 💕

I contacted Morgane very soon after my puppy arrived to start training as early as possible. The result: Marley is a well-adjusted dog who learns very quickly, loves playing with all dogs, and adores people. Morgane is a great listener; she takes the time to understand your dog's behavior and environment. I particularly appreciated that she came to my home first to do an assessment. Then we tried walks on a leash, interactions with other dogs, and daily exercises for managing emotions. These are truly customized sessions, and that's what makes them so great! Thank you again, Morgane, for your work with Marley.

I highly recommend Morgane for her gentleness and expertise. She immediately understood what needed improvement with Roméo following the abuse he suffered and gave us advice and methods that we could implement immediately after our appointment!
Full of great advice for bringing my deaf puppy home! I highly recommend it 🙂 …

I had the opportunity to meet Morgane because of some behavioral problems with Sequoia, my little chow chow. I am very happy with the work Morgane did; she opened my eyes to techniques for reconnecting with my best friend.

I am very grateful to her. I highly recommend her services and commend her kindness and professionalism.

I contacted Morgane for positive dog training sessions after my dog ​​developed behavioral problems.

She was able to build a wonderful relationship with him and restore our peaceful bond.

She's a fantastic dog behaviorist; if you're in Marseille, I highly recommend her.
Morgane is a fantastic trainer; she immediately put Néo at ease and helped us completely resolve the issues we encountered. All this with great kindness, patience, and always with a smile! …

I contacted Morgane when my puppy arrived. She is very attentive, very gentle, always available, and offers excellent advice. She taught me patience and consistency, and helped me understand my dog's behavior. I recommend her without hesitation!
Morgan is very friendly and was a great help. She continues to give us advice.
